messages:
Maya Chen: Quick org/ hiring update — two small changes to call out today:
Maya Chen: 1) Please welcome Diego Morales, who starts Monday 03/01 as Senior Customer Reliability PM on the Customer Success + Platform pod. Diego will partner with CS engineers to own reliability playbooks and with Platform PMs on SLAs and rollout runbooks. He’s remote (PST) and joining from a Payments infra background.
Maya Chen: 2) Samir Das will move from eng-runtime -> eng-sre as interim Runtime SRE Lead to cover until we close the SRE backfill. Samir’s first day in the new scope is next week; he’ll keep a dotted line into runtime for ongoing projects.
Maya Chen: TL;DR: Diego = new hire for CS/Platform reliability; Samir = internal shift + backfill to recruit.
Avery Patel: Congrats Diego 👏 welcome!!
Diego Morales: Super excited to join — thanks for the warm welcome. Looking forward to meeting folks. I’ll schedule 30m intro slots next week for handoffs.
Lina Chavez: Welcome Diego! FYI we added Diego to the Redbook access group and Slack. If anyone needs anything from People Ops re: onboarding let me know.
People Ops Bot: HR checklist: Diego Morales — paperwork completed ✅ benefits enrolled pending (2 business days). Welcome kit shipped.
Samir Das: Happy to take the interim lead. I’ll post the updated oncall and rotation notes by EOD Friday.
Rachel Nguyen: Quick Q — who owns the SLA doc for external-facing endpoints now? Need to update contact list.
Maya Chen: @Rachel good call — Diego will be primary; Samir will be secondary until backfill. I’ll update the runbook links: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/sla-endpoints
Avery Patel: I can be a mentor for Diego on platform infra specifics, @Diego feel free to ping me to set up a pairing session.
Diego Morales: Thanks @Avery — would love that.
Lina Chavez: Managers: please schedule customary 30/60/90 check-ins for Diego (template: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/30-60-90). Also note relocation stipend processed in People Ops.
Maya Chen: Recruiting note: we’ve opened the SRE backfill req (JR-487). Hiring managers please review candidates in Greenhouse this week; we want interviews to start next Tues.
Samir Das: I’ll add a short doc with what I’m handing off to the new hire: /docs/runtime-interim-handbook.md
Diego Morales: Does anyone have a short list of priority bugs or alerts I should look at day 1?
Avery Patel: I’ll DM you a short list and add you to the alerting channel.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — no all-hands here, just wanted to make sure folks who need to know have the heads-up. Ping me or @Lina if there are any blockers for Diego’s onboarding or the SRE hiring timeline. :party_parrot:
Lina Chavez: Welcome again Diego :welcome:
People Ops Bot: Reminder: All new hire security trainings must be completed within 7 days of start date.
